labs.pi_title: Chair, Department of Landscape Architecture; Peter Louis Hornbeck Professor in Practice of Landscape Architecture; Faculty Fellow of the Arnold Arboretum
labs.research_summary: Landscape architect focused on the urban forest canopy; founding principal of Reed Hilderbrand, a landscape architecture practice.

labs.pi_title: Climate Action Acceleration Professor of Organismic and Evolutionary Biology; Director, Harvard University Herbaria; Faculty Fellow of the Arnold Arboretum
labs.research_summary: Plant physiological ecologist studying how evolutionary history of plant function shapes ecosystem processes, using spectral biology approaches.
labs.notes: Also directs Harvard University Herbaria (separate target harvard-herbaria, not yet scraped) and chairs the Harvard Forest Leadership Committee.

labs.pi_title: Professor of Organismic and Evolutionary Biology; Charles Bullard Professor of Forestry; Faculty Fellow of the Arnold Arboretum
labs.research_summary: The Holbrook lab studies how transport of water and solutes through the plant vascular system influences ecological, evolutionary and physiological processes.
labs.notes: Primary appointment/lab likely in Harvard OEB (separate target, not yet scraped).

labs.pi_title: Professor of Organismic and Evolutionary Biology; Faculty Fellow of the Arnold Arboretum
labs.research_summary: The Hopkins lab studies natural selection and speciation using color variation in Phlox, focusing on reproductive incompatibility between emerging species.
labs.notes: Primary appointment/lab likely in Harvard OEB (separate target, not yet scraped).

labs.pi_title: Arnold Professor of Organismic and Evolutionary Biology; Director of the Arnold Arboretum; Faculty Fellow of the Arnold Arboretum
labs.research_summary: The Friedman lab studies organismic interfaces between developmental, phylogenetic and evolutionary biology, and how development shapes plant morphology and reproduction.
labs.notes: Director of the Arnold Arboretum overall; primary appointment/lab likely in Harvard OEB (separate target, not yet scraped).
